title: Habit tracker
body: La mejor app q he probado hasta ahora, simple y facil de utilizar.
author: PAULAMAISINTHEHOUSE

title: Vendor Lock
body: Out of nowhere, the developer decided to disable CSV exports. Thus, now years of data are stuck in this app, and you are forced to keep paying, no matter the price, if you don't want to lose all your history. Don't use this app. Extremely shady practices here.
author: Nicky894

title: Widgets
body: Los widgets siguen sin ser interactivos, cuando los añades a la pantalla de inicio no te deja marcar el “tic” sin entrar en la app
author: Victor Rubira 3

title: Another app that makes you pay to use it
body: It only lets you add 2 goals before having to pay
author: bdj232

title: Lo que estaba buscando
body: App simple pero con lo que necesita. En concreto poder apuntar fechas antiguas que muchas otras apps de este tipo no te dejan
author: jaimegmez

title: Solo 2 hábitos
body: La app está genial pero en el plan gratuito solo deja añadir 2 hábitos…
author: LLAMAME UNICORNIO

title: Muy buena app
body: App muy simple y fácil de usar con unos tonos que personalmente me encantan, un 10 la vd
author: Alberpito04

title: Un antes y después
body: Para las girls que quieren mejorar en hábitos en ser más constantes, odio las suscripciones así que pague la versión lifetime de un solo pago, a modo de inversión y no me arrepiento, súper fácil de personalizar y adaptar al gusto, aesthetic y necesidades de cada uno
author: Cristinadsr

title: Intuitive and beautiful
body: What a wonderful app! The widgets are useful to get a reminder as I don’t like getting notifications. A widget in the Home Screen is for me more useful than a random notification, because who doesn’t browse their phone? 🫣 I also like that the design feels very Apple-ish so I got used in no-time to use the app. Good job! 👏🏼
author: Isasimo

title: Just what I was looking for
body: Tried some apps during a lot of days and this app just matched with my requierements. Simple and easy to use.
author: Northen0

title: La mejor app
body: Gratuita y sencillamente sencilla, si de verdad quieres cambiar, esta es tu app.
author: vgropsan

title: Genial!
body: Es una de las apps de tracking de hábitos que más recomiendo. Lo único que echo en falta son widgets para seguir el progreso en la pantalla principal. Espero que lo incluyan pronto.
author: Chiyowski

title: Very good and useful
body: Really good
author: Sloppard

title: Simple yet so great!
body: It let’s me add as much habits as I want, unlike other apps. That’s just what I needed :)
author: vaaluna

title: Great!
body:
This app has helped me quit smoking! :) Also i have now the habit of going for a walk and I have been tracking how many days a week I leave from work early which has helped me to avoid a burn out.

Thanks!
author: Diana_rev

title: Simple but effective
body:
I love how easy it is use, but at the same time it is soooo visually satisfying! :)
I recently started to use this app to create a new learning habit and I love ticking the box every day and to see in the yearly view how my new custom is taking up more and more space :)

title: simple, perfecta
body: la más simple y perfecta que hace lo único que necesito que haga. contar días de logros para algo concreto. la pagaba dos veces. de nuevo.

title: Amazing
body: Simple and clear. Perfect for me!

title: Muy útil
body: Esta muy bien para llevar un control de tus hábitos. Muy completa además
author: MewLoz

title: Easy to use, but powerful app
body: I’ve tried a lot of those apps that pretend to help us to create or establish new habits. And, for me, this is the best one. Simple, easy to use, without useless complexities, but a very useful app.
author: Frio Glacial

title: Fantastic!
body: It’s a fantastic app to track and make yout own habits! But I saw a mistake, that is when I want to change the app icon it doesn’t work!!! I don’t know why ?? If the fix it, It would be an amazing app (9/10⭐️)

title: Congrats 👏👏👏
body: Great! I needed some motivation for tracking my habits and this app helps me a lot! Very useful 😉 thank you!
